title: Works great.  Would prefer a weighted gauge.
text:
Works great. Would prefer a weighted gauge.. I love the look of this cooker. The lid locks into place. It works just as well as other cookers. It well made with heavy stainless steel.

I personally prefer the weighted gauge that does the jiggle to let you know if the pressure is too high but I do like that you can choose more or less pressure with the little dial on top.

Cooks food quickly. A bit more expensive than the presto cookers.
